name: RetroMania
blurb: A one-day Swiss retrogaming and geek-culture fair in Payerne, with a geek flea market, arcade cabinets, tournaments and a cosplay contest.
notes: Homepage reads '25 avril 2026, 11h-19h Payerne, Halle des Fêtes' for its 8th edition, a one-day fair that already passed as of this check (2026-10-05); its own countdown timer is at zero and no 2027 date is posted on the site (only an 'Affiche_2026' poster, no 2027 poster yet) or found via search, so editions is empty and April 2026 is recorded as 'last'. Guests were not collected since there is no upcoming edition; this is a flea-market/arcade-and-tournament fair rather than a celebrity-guest convention. A 'logo-wavemind-media.svg' appears in the footer alongside the Retromania logo but it's not clearly labeled as the organizer (could be a web/production credit), so organizer was left blank rather than guessed. Used the official 2026 event poster ('Affiche retromania') as cover, the best available key art.
